title: Pricing and Credits
description: The official waoowaoo cloud edition will use credits for AI text, image, video, and music generation. These are beta placeholder prices and can be updated before paid launch.
betaNotice: Self-service top-up is not available during the official beta. Users can receive trial credits through invite codes or manual admin grants. The prices below describe the planned paid version for payment review and do not mean checkout is currently enabled.

creditPolicy.title: Credit rules
creditPolicy.body: Credits are in-platform AI generation units. They are not cash, cannot be withdrawn, cannot be transferred, and cannot be used outside the platform. Actual deductions depend on task type, model, resolution, duration, and other factors. When paid checkout launches, final pricing, currency, taxes, and checkout entry points will be shown.
